## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      14 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 23 juil. 2026 - 23 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _CAS853_, 23 août 2026, 1/5: "Very buggy app. Often unable to end rides due to dropped connection, and rides only unlocking the bike 1 minute into the ride time. Hard to report damaged bikes on app (compared to lime) so bikes you unlock often have mechanical problems"
            2. _Surgef_, 22 août 2026, 1/5: "I had been using Forest for a while but the app is notoriously buggy and can cause a lot of delays/issues. I had app issues where I was overcharged multiple times due to bundles not working and rides not ending and it is impossible to get an answer from customer service. I would recommend not using Forest and instead using Lime as a much more reliable bike app."
            3. _jokal3112_, 11 août 2026, 1/5: "Absolute worst customer service I've ever experienced. My bike was broken, so I couldn't end the ride — the timer just kept running. I then tried every way possible to reach support: emailed 5 times (no response), called twice (couldn't get through), tried live chat twice (it's frozen), and even the email address listed on the website is no longer a working address. Not a single contact channel actually works. On top of that, I regularly lose minutes from my 1,200-minute subscription to broken bikes, and reported bugs never get reimbursed. I had to buy an extra 500-minute bundle, which is now being drained by the exact same issue. The referral bonus I was promised for friends who signed up also never showed up. An app you can't actually reach anyone through when something goes wrong isn't usable. Can't recommend this right now."
